action_items.detail: tests/test_tscheck_lead_status.py and tests/test_tscheck_excel_export.py create fixture leads with a static phone number (081200000000) instead of a unique-per-run phone, so every backend suite run permanently grows that number's duplicate_count in the shared DB. This slowly pollutes the 'Prioritas SLA & duplikat' panel's top-12 ranking (already at duplicate_count=21 after this session's reruns). Not a bug in the feature under test today, but should be fixed by giving those two files unique phone numbers per run to stop the unbounded residue growth.
